open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.
Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: French Genealogy & Family History Enthusiasts
proposals.buyer_persona: French seniors and family historians ('généalogistes amateurs') who spend hours on Geneanet and departmental archives, looking to organize their research and display their heritage.
product_angles: Highly structured Genealogy Logbooks (Cahiers de recherche généalogique) for KDP
Fillable family tree posters with French vintage aesthetics (18th-century style)
Stickers and planner inserts for tracking archival discoveries (archives départementales)
proposals.first_test_product: A 120-page 'Mon Cahier de Généalogie' on Amazon KDP with pre-formatted ancestor sheets and research logs.

proposals.name: Solo Tabletop RPG (Solo TTRPG) Players
proposals.buyer_persona: Gamers who play tabletop roleplaying games alone. They rely heavily on 'oracles', physical journals, prompt tables, and highly atmospheric visual aids to drive their narratives.
product_angles: A5-sized Solo RPG journaling zines and prompt books on KDP
Printable 'Oracle' card decks with atmospheric, high-contrast monochrome art
Hex-crawl map templates and minimalist character sheets
proposals.first_test_product: A print-on-demand Oracle Deck of 54 cards with evocative dark-fantasy illustrations and prompt words.

proposals.name: Auxiliaires Spécialisées Vétérinaires (ASV) - French Vet Nurses
proposals.buyer_persona: Overworked, passionate French veterinary assistants. They share strong inside jokes about difficult pet owners, specific medical terms, and weird animal behaviors.
product_angles: Sarcastic French quote stickers and mugs for the vet clinic breakroom
Educational and stress-relief coloring books specifically tailored to vet nurses
Daily planners optimized for veterinary clinic shifts
proposals.first_test_product: A sarcastic French coloring book 'Vie d'ASV: Entre griffes et café' on Amazon KDP.

proposals.name: Micro-Museums & Local Heritage Sites in France
proposals.buyer_persona: Curators and volunteers running small municipal museums, castles, or regional heritage houses looking for low-cost, unique gift shop merchandise.
product_angles: Custom local coloring books depicting the town's specific castle or historical event
Line-art SVG vector packs of local monuments for their own merchandise use
Vintage-style travel posters of minor French villages
proposals.first_test_product: A localized coloring book focused on a specific tourist valley (e.g., 'Colorie le Patrimoine de la Vallée de la Meuse') pitched directly to local tourist offices via email.

proposals.name: 2D Pixel Art UI & Asset Packs for Solo Gamedevs
proposals.buyer_persona: Solo indie game developers who need quick, cohesive, and high-quality UI assets (buttons, icons, inventory frames) for their prototypes or final games.
product_angles: Themed pixel-art icon packs (e.g., 'Cyberpunk UI', 'Cozy Farming Icons')
Seamless tileable background textures for 2D side-scrollers
Spells and status effect icon sheets
proposals.first_test_product: A pack of 200+ RPG item icons (potions, weapons, loot) in pixel-art style, sold on Itch.io and Unity Asset Store.

proposals.name: French 'Sapeurs-Pompiers Volontaires' (Volunteer Firefighters)
proposals.buyer_persona: The 197,000+ volunteer firefighters in France who have an immense pride in their service, active community centers (Amicales), and a culture of gift-giving during firemen's balls and end-of-year calendars.
product_angles: Humorous and pride-themed t-shirts and hoodies on Redbubble
Customizable shift logbooks and training trackers on KDP
Mugs and stickers with inside jokes about 'le bip' (pager) and interventions
proposals.first_test_product: A dedicated 'Carnet de Notes du Sapeur-Pompier Volontaire' with shift tracking and training logs.
